crossRefs.note: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these…

people.name: Agrippa
people.line: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea

translations.web: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”
translations.bsb: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do.”
translations.kjv: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
translations.asv: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
